title: The symmetric algebra of a finite projective module is smooth
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $M$ a finite projective $A$-module (a direct summand of a finite free $A$-module), and $\operatorname{Sym}_A(M)$ its symmetric algebra [lem-weil-pbc-symmetric-algebra-universal-property]. Then the structure map $A\to\operatorname{Sym}_A(M)$ is a smooth ring map [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map].

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 07M6 (lemma-symmetric-algebra-smooth, line 2112), the implication 'M finite projective => Sym_A(M) smooth' (second paragraph of its proof, using Lemma Tag 07EV lemma-cotangent-complex-symmetric-algebra)

proof.text: A finite projective A-module M is finitely presented: a splitting of a finite free surjection identifies its kernel with a finitely generated direct summand. This is Mathlib Module.finitePresentation_of_projective. Apply the finite-presentation clause of [lem-weil-pbc-symmetric-algebra-finite-presentation] to obtain that Sym_A(M) is a finitely presented A-algebra.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00NX (lemma-finite-projective), finite projective modules are finitely presented; Lemma Tag 00DO (lemma-presentation-sym-exterior) for the symmetric-algebra presentation

proof.text: For any commutative A-algebra B, ideal I with I squared zero, and A-algebra map f:Sym_A(M) -> B/I, restrict f to M using iota. The quotient map B -> B/I is surjective as an A-linear map. Projectivity [def-weil-pbc-projective-module] supplies an A-linear lift g:M -> B of f composed with iota. Extend g to an A-algebra map Sym_A(M) -> B using [lem-weil-pbc-symmetric-algebra-universal-property]. Its composite with the quotient map agrees with f on every iota(m), by the linear lifting equation and SymmetricAlgebra.lift_ι_apply, so the uniqueness clause SymmetricAlgebra.algHom_ext makes the composite equal to f. Mathlib Algebra.FormallySmooth.of_comp_surjective therefore proves formal smoothness.

source.place: Algebra, Definition Tag 05CE and Lemma Tag 05CF (lemma-characterize-projective), lifting characterization; Section Tag 00DM, universal property of symmetric algebras; Section Tag 00TI, infinitesimal lifting criterion for formal smoothness

proof.text: Combine the finite presentation from step 1 with formal smoothness from step 2 using Algebra.Smooth.mk, the characterization of smoothness [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map]. This proves the original statement with the same independent universes and hypotheses.
